title: New Part Sale shows no Bill To field
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as another customer, so a default exists that the window could show.
  • Start on the Part Sales page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Part Sale window opens.

Step 2:

  • Customer A is picked.
  • The window shows no "Bill To" or "Bill Invoices To" field.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R8: “New Work Order and New Part Sale show no Bill To.”
  • Out of Scope: “Bill To in New Work Order and New Part Sale. Neither window changes. A saved default applies on create and the Bill To is changed on the Customer card afterwards.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
